name: switch
title: Switch
description: Styled Solid switch component backed by Keystone selection-control behavior.

meta.customization: Style the generated wrappers through mason-switch classes while Keystone keeps role=switch, checked state, hidden input, and preventable toggle behavior.

parity.baseUi: Thin vertical covers controlled and uncontrolled checked state, disabled/read-only guards, role=switch, hidden checkbox submission, hidden-input state metadata, user-handler precedence, and Mason wrapper metadata. Gaps: cursor/touch drag semantics, richer field composition, form validation edge cases, animation lifecycle data, and hydration edge tests remain follow-up work.
parity.kobalte: Matches Solid Switch Root/Input/Control/Thumb direction with checked state, hidden native input, disabled/read-only state, preventable toggle behavior, and stable data attributes. Gaps: form-control registration depth, validation/reset semantics, and transition lifecycle helpers remain follow-up work.
